thread:
Maya: Quick question — for first-run onboarding, do we want a persistent progress breadcrumb in the top header or a transient mini-tour pill that appears under the hero? Thinking about discoverability vs. noise.
Alex: I lean breadcrumb in header. It's discoverable and always reachable, especially for users who step away and come back.
Jordan: Breadcrumb is clearer for progress, but can be heavy on small screens. Can we collapse into a single icon on narrow widths?
Sam: From implementation POV header breadcrumb is easier to attach to routing state. Mini-tour needs more timing logic and re-entry state. Also affects initial paint.
Toni: Accessibility note — if persistent, ensure it's reachable via keyboard and we expose aria-current / role=status for the active step. If transient, make sure screen readers get a clear announcement when it appears.
Maya: Good call on aria-current. For small screens maybe we show a condensed "Step 2 of 4" chip in header that opens a flyout with full checklist. That keeps consistency.
Alex: Love that. Visual idea: breadcrumb text + a subtle progress bar below header on desktop, chip on mobile. I'll mock both.
Jordan: Copy-wise, avoid verbs like "Complete" on the chip. Use task-oriented copy: "Add API key", "Create sample project" — shorter strings.
Sam: If we do flyout, we can lazy-load the checklist content to keep initial bundle small. Also add a localStorage flag to mark dismissed mini-tour.
Toni: Also propose focus management: when a user completes a step via the flyout, focus should return to the triggering control. And if they dismiss, set aria-hidden on the flyout.
Maya: I'll update the mock and include the keyboard flow in the handoff. Can someone weigh in on analytics events? We want to track opens, step completions, and dismissals.
Jordan: I'll add events: onboarding.open, onboarding.step_complete, onboarding.dismissed. Count unique users and time-to-complete.
Alex: Quick UI nit — make sure contrast of the chip meets 4.5:1 for body text and 3:1 for large. I'll run the colors through the checker.
deploy-bot: Reminder: user-telemetry feature flag "onboard_ui_v2" will be on in staging tomorrow 09:00 UTC.
Sam: Perfect, I'll wire up flag gating for the breadcrumb vs chip and add unit tests for responsive behavior.
Maya: Thanks all — I'll drop updated mocks and a short AX checklist by EOD. :thumbsup:
